title: City Briefed on Electricity Competition
summary:
*   Austin leaders received a staff briefing regarding competition in the electric utility industry.
*   This was a special, closed-door meeting held in executive session, primarily for informational purposes.
*   No public discussions, debates, or new policy decisions were made during this session.
